messages:
sylvia: Heads-up: staging canary promotion blocked by CI failing artifact validation at publish. deploy-bot auto-paused.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: job `ci/publish/wheel-publish` failed - remote registry rejected artifact due to checksum mismatch. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1779998888
yuri: Key log excerpt:
```
[2026-05-03T08:12:21Z] uploading wheel redwood_server-1.2.3-py3-none-any.whl
registry: expected checksum sha256:3a7b1f... but got sha256:9f2c4d...
ERROR: artifact validation failed: checksum mismatch
```
cleo: We recently upgraded the manylinux builder image and also added a post-build gzip step to reduce transfer size. Could be one of those changes introducing non-determinism in wheel metadata or compression ordering.
mark: I can repro locally: two builds of the same commit on different runners give different wheel hashes when the timestamp and RECORD ordering differ. The registry verifies the wheel file stream checksum; non-deterministic metadata is the culprit.
sylvia: Change window is open. Options: 1) revert the manylinux image upgrade (pin to last-good image sha256:aa11bb22) 2) disable post-build gzip for publish step 3) force deterministic wheel builds (strip timestamps). Which is least risky for the release?
ops-bot: Policy: temporary pin or rollback allowed during open change window. Manual promote requires eng-releases + eng-pkg approvals.
yuri: Minimal blast radius = disable gzip in publish pipeline. That should avoid changing the raw wheel stream. We should still follow up with deterministic wheel builds.
cleo: Agreed. I'll open a PR to flip the publish flag and add a CI job that builds the wheel twice and compares hashes as a regression test.
deploy-bot: PR #6123 opened: ci/publish - disable gzip upload; add wheel-determinism job. CI triggered.
build-bot: CI job wheel-determinism for PR #6123: run1 sha256=3a7b1f..., run2 sha256=3a7b1f... (match). All checks green.
deploy-bot: CI for PR #6123 completed: status=success.
sylvia: Requesting manual promote now that publish succeeded without gzip.
sylvia: /promote canary-2026-05-03 --manual
deploy-bot: Promotion recorded. Required approvals: eng-releases (mark), eng-pkg (cleo).
mark: Approved.
cleo: Approved.
deploy-bot: Promotion progressing: 0% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Health checks passing. Promotion complete.
sylvia: Release unblocked. Adding follow-up ticket RW-4302: "wheel checksum drift - root cause: non-deterministic wheel metadata introduced by builder image; short-term: disabled gzip on publish; long-term: enforce deterministic builds (strip timestamps, canonicalize RECORD, pin build image)."
yuri: I'll own the deterministic build work and will propose a patch to strip timestamps and pin the manylinux image to a stable digest in RW-4302.
mark: Also adding an alert to CI if wheel-digest-diff >0 in post-merge smoke job.
sylvia: Draft release note: "Temporarily disabled publish gzip after transient wheel checksum mismatches in CI prevented artifact acceptance; deterministic wheel builds and pinning planned (RW-4302)."
cleo: Thanks team. Closing thread — will follow up on RW-4302 and merge the deterministic-build PR once tested.
